<ins>Formula for Applying to Bruises and Swelling from Falls (敷跌打青腫方)</ins>
Raw gardenia (生梔子) together with sifted flour (飛羅面), pound and apply; wrap with cloth, and when the blue poison is drawn out, the swelling will subside. <ins>Yang-Returning Jade Dragon Ointment (回陽玉龍膏)</ins> Specially applied to injuries from falls and blows with qi deficiency and cold. Aconite (草烏, stir-fried, two qian), arisaema (南星, roasted, one liang), junjiang (軍姜, roasted, one liang), angelica dahurica (白芷, one liang), red peony (赤芍, stir-fried, one liang), cinnamon bark (肉桂, five qian)
Grind all together into powder, mix with scallion water (蔥湯) and rub on; hot wine may also be used.
